## Reference-Area Trajectories

Thin lines in @fig-series-trajectories show individual reference areas; the emphasized line shows the mean of observed reference-area values in each period. 

Hover over a line to identify the reference area. 

Use the missingness matrix in @fig-series-missingness to select a reference area or a specific reference-area–time-period observation.

::: {#fig-series-trajectories}
<div id="series-trajectories"></div>

Reference-area trajectories for <span class="series-caption-name" data-series-caption></span>
<span class="object-caption-subtitle" data-series-unit></span>
:::

## Panel Missingness

Each cell represents one reference area–time-period combination on the analytical series' observed temporal support. Hover over a filled cell to inspect its value and, when available, its OECD observation-status flag. Click a reference-area name to highlight its full trajectory, or click an observed cell to highlight both the reference area's trajectory and that specific observation.

::: {#fig-series-missingness}
<div id="series-missingness"></div>

Reference area–time-period observation coverage for the selected analytical series.
<span class="series-caption-name" data-series-caption></span>
:::
